entry.title: New: RES23-265 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TUITION, TRANSPORTATION, MEALS, AND LODGING, VALUED AT $37,600, TO THE CITY FROM THE BLOOMBERG HARVARD CITY LEADERSHIP INITIATIVE FOR A MEMBER FROM THE MANAGING DIRECTOR'S OFFICE, THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES, THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES, AND THE DEPARTMENT OF PLANNING AND PERMITTING TO PARTICIPATE IN THE "MANAGING TALENT IN CITY GOVERNMENT: RECRUITING, RETAINING AND SUPPORTING EMPLOYEES" PROGRAM IN CAMBRIDGE, MASSACHUSETTS, FROM OCTOBER 29 TO NOVEMBER 3, 2023.

Latest action: Adopted.
